notes.title: Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite - Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
After last big update, a couple of bugs sneaked by, so I'll be addressing some of them. There are also new features, because some quality of life is always good to see :). 

Below is the comprehensive list of changes in this update:

[h3]Main Menu changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Puzzles image preview[/b]
When selecting files to create custom puzzles, you will now see an image preview of the selected file.
[*][b]What's new menu[/b]
What's new menu (the bell icon on the main menu) has been reworked. It will now show patch notes ingame, instead of opening an external link to Steam announcement. 
[/list]

[h3]Pause Menu changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Static puzzle highlight toggle[/b]
As per requested, it's now possible to turn on the legacy behavior of the puzzle piece shader. When enabled, the puzzle piece highlight/shadow will be static (as in rotate with the piece), and will hint at the correct puzzle piece orientation.
The option is available in Pause Menu > Gameplay > Static puzzle piece shadow.
[*][b]Audio sliders tooltip[/b]
Audio volume sliders will now show a tooltip when hovered. The tooltip displays the current percent value of the slider.
[*][b]Adjusted default settings[/b]
Default starting rotation is now set to 90 degree. 
Default puzzle piece snapping is now set to 40% instead of 100%, which was too much to start with. 
Only the default values changed, if the setting was adjusted before, the saved value will be used.
[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an additional check in save data to check for corrupted files and use the backup save in such case.
[*][b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Sort By Section order to be flipped in ~200 pc puzzles (again).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused custom puzzles tagged at creation to not save the tag properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused zen mode starting puzzle piece to be shifted
[/list]
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update,
Bartek

notes.title: Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite - Update 1.2, Cats & Dogs Puzzle Pack
notes.notes:
Starting the new year with good vibes, Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite gets a new update and a puzzle pack.
This time we'll be assembling puzzles showing our beloved pets: cats and dogs :). 

Until the end of the week, there will be a discount for the Full Unlock DLC, so grab it when it's hot :).

Below is the comprehensive list of changes in this update:

[h3]New puzzle pack[/h3]
Cats and Dogs puzzle pack is available for download. It's a separate DLC that contains additional puzzles. Of course, as with any update, this is free to download. It contains 20 free puzzles and 64 additional ones for owners of the Full Unlock DLC.

[h3]Pause Menu changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Backgrounds[/b]
Background selection has changed. Now there's an additional menu in Pause Menu > Display > Customize. This menu allows to click on a desired background to select it instead of cycling through all backgrounds. 
There's also an option to add any number of custom backgrounds with a color of your choice!
[*][b]Pixel perfect toggle[/b]
You can now disable pixel perfect pickup. This means that instead of having to click on a visible pixel of a puzzle piece, you can select it by clicking on the area it occupies.
[*][b]Borderless fullscreen option[/b]
You can now select Borderless Fullscreen as a window type.
[*][b]Congratulation confetti toggle[/b]
You can now disable confetti effect playing after the puzzle is finished. 
[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Sort By Section order to be flipped
[*] Fixed a bug which moved the puzzle piece randomly after picking it directly after interacting with a second monitor
[*] Puzzle piece bevel no longer shows the correct puzzle piece orientation
[/list]
[*] Updated the game engine to Godot 3.5.3
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update and have a great 2024!
Bartek

notes.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Infinite - Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
The wait is over, update 1.1.0 for Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite is here. 
Thank you everyone for the suggestions in Steam discussion boards, many of them were included in this release. 

[b]The day this event goes live, starting 7PM CEST, there will be a weeklong discount for the Full Unlock DLC, so grab it when it's fresh :). [/b]

Below is the comprehensive list of changes in this update.
[list]
[*] [b]New puzzle pack:[/b]
Classic puzzle pack is available for download. It's a separate DLC that contains additional puzzles. All new puzzle packs will be added in a similar way, so they can be added/removed freely. 
Of course, as with any update, this is free to download. It contains 20 free puzzles and 50 additional ones for owners of the Full Unlock DLC.
[/list]
[b]Main Menu changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Puzzles are now grouped into tabs: [/b]
For original puzzles, each tab represents a puzzle pack. 
For custom puzzles, each tab contains puzzles tagged with a specific tag. 
[*] [b]Custom puzzles tagging: [/b]
You can now create tags for custom puzzles to sort them more easily. Tags can be freely added, removed and renamed. Only one tag per puzzle is allowed, so if you add a puzzle to a new tag, it will be moved out from the old one. There is a special tab - 'All', which can not be modified and will contain all custom puzzles. 
[i]You can access the tagging feature by clicking the tag icon when Custom puzzles are selected.
[/i][*] [b]Favorite puzzles:[/b]
In addition to tags, there is now favorite functionality as well. Favorite puzzles will be moved to the top of their respective tab. 
[i]You can access this function by clicking the star icon in the main menu. [/i]
[*] [b]Hover animations were changes for puzzle thumbnails and save slots to no longer blur the images.[/b]
[*] [b]Add custom puzzle button got moved. It's now together with the Favorite and Tab button on top.[/b]
[/list]

[b]Other changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Custom cursors:[/b]
There are now multiple custom cursors for different situations. 
[*] [b]Bigger puzzles:[/b]
The puzzle size limit was increased to 8000 pieces. When selecting piece counts over 2000, a warning tooltip appears. It can be disabled in the options menu.
[*] [b]Control info:[/b]
You will now see a panel with mouse controls changing dynamically in-game. There's also a popup with hotkeys available by pressing the F2 key (also mentioned in the controls panel). 
The controls panel can be hidden/shown by pressing F1 key, or selecting a corresponding option in the options menu. 
[*] [b]Puzzle preview in-game was fixed:[/b]
Previously, puzzle preview was a bit hidden and many people asked about this functionality not knowing it was in the game already. There is now a button to access puzzle preview (of course Tab key can be used as well). 
[*] [b]Third spread - Spiral.[/b]
[*] [b]Starting camera zoom level now changes depending on the piece count.[/b]
[*] [b]New backgrounds added.[/b]
[*] [b]Multiselected pieces can now be rotated.[/b]
[*] [b]There is now a percentage progress indicator when generating a new puzzle.[/b]
[*] [b]Pieces locking in frame can be disabled now (for classic mode):[/b]
This setting is on a per save basis and can be changed in the Customize menu. Default option can be selected in the options menu. This cannot be changed after the puzzle is generated.
[*] [b]Right click menu now has 'Unstuck' option which will spread joined pieces in addition to single ones.[/b]
[*] [b]Small variations in puzzle shapes were added.[/b]
[*] [b]Options menu is now grouped into section using tabs[/b]
[/list]

Keep on puzzling, 
Bartek

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - 1.0.9 - Fixes and small features
notes.notes:
[b]We're crossing 2500 downloads today! Huge thank you to all the players![/b]

This time Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite is getting some small features in addition to fixes. 

[b]Changelog: [/b]

[b][u]Added in 1.0.9[/u][/b]
- [Bugfix] Fix for game crashing on adding a custom image with specific dimensions/ratio sometimes (thanks danielmulvey)

[b][u]Added in 1.0.8[/u][/b]
 - [Bugfix] Fixed miscounting connected pieces when loading in some specific cases

[b][u]Added in 1.0.7[/u][/b]
 - [Feature] Logs in release version will now show more messages to make future debugging easier. 

[b][u]Added in 1.0.6[/u][/b]
- [Bugfix] Fixed pieces in frame getting shifted position sometimes when loading (thank you Geeky Guy, Blossomflower and Count Maledictus)
- [Bugfix] Fixed under/overcounting connected pieces (thank you Lrrr, Kathykins and Jesso)
- [Bugfix] Fixed issue with 100% progress displaying on a save slot for large puzzles with low amount of connected pieces
- [Bugfix] Fixed a rare issue with loading Zen mode

[b][u]Added in 1.0.5[/u][/b]
- [Bugfix] Fixed issue with disappearing mouse when pressing escape with multiselected pieces picked up.(thanks uwulicious)

[b][u]Added in 1.0.4[/u][/b]
- [Feature] Starting rotation now offers 3 settings: OFF, Snap to 90 Degress and Full
- [Feature] Added a new button in game. It allows to open Settings menu without pressing Escape
- [Feature] Added saving window size when in Windowed mode. The game will keep the previous window size when relaunching in Windowed mode or when switching from Fullscreen to Windowed mode
- [Feature] Puzzle completion celebration - Added Main Menu button after celebration ends 

- [Bugfix] Fix for miscounting connected pieces in some conditions
- [Bugfix] Puzzle completion celebration - Added dynamic generation of particles for any window size

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Another batch of small fixes
notes.notes:
This is another small update with a couple of fixes:

- Fixed pieces being misaligned when joining to the puzzle grid in some specific circumstances
- Fixed bug with cursor sometimes being in wrong state when spamming Esc (open/close menu)

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Fixes
notes.notes:
This is a small update with a couple of fixes:

- Fixed background in a couple of screens that were missed earlier. 
- Fixed a rare bug that caused the game to crash and losing the current save when going back to main menu (thanks Lonely FireWolf and Xohr)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Adaptive UI
notes.notes:
First of all, a huge thank you to all the players. 
I'm actively monitoring the Steam forums for comments, suggestions and bug reports. 

This is a small update with a feature that I missed for the release - adaptive UI. 
The interface will now adapt to the window size. There are no black bars on widescreen resolutions and no small text on smaller screens. 

Minimum window size is locked to 1200x768 (which should cover basically any PC/laptop screen) and is freely resizable.
